cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(OpenMS_BoostFreeConsumer CXX)
include(CTest)

set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_Boost TRUE)
find_package(OpenMS CONFIG REQUIRED)

# Even a Boost installation in the compiler's default search path must not mask
# an accidental public include. Shadow its headers with deliberate errors.
if(NOT OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT OR NOT EXISTS "${OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT}/boost/config.hpp")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT must identify the producer's Boost headers")
endif()
set(_poison "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/no-boost")
file(GLOB_RECURSE _boost_headers RELATIVE "${OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT}"
  "${OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT}/boost/*.h" "${OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT}/boost/*.hpp"
  "${OPENMS_BOOST_HEADER_ROOT}/boost/*.ipp")
foreach(_header IN LISTS _boost_headers)
  get_filename_component(_directory "${_poison}/${_header}" DIRECTORY)
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_directory}")
  file(WRITE "${_poison}/${_header}" "#error An installed OpenMS header requires Boost\n")
endforeach()

add_library(public_headers OBJECT)
target_link_libraries(public_headers PRIVATE OpenMS::OpenMS)
target_include_directories(public_headers BEFORE PRIVATE "${_poison}")
set(_header_count 0)
foreach(_target IN ITEMS OpenMS::OpenMS OpenMS::OpenSwathAlgo)
  get_target_property(_links ${_target} INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
  if(_links MATCHES "Boost::")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "${_target} still exports Boost: ${_links}")
  endif()
  get_target_property(_sets ${_target} INTERFACE_HEADER_SETS)
  foreach(_set IN LISTS _sets)
    if(_set STREQUAL "HEADERS")
      get_target_property(_headers ${_target} HEADER_SET)
    else()
      get_target_property(_headers ${_target} HEADER_SET_${_set})
    endif()
    foreach(_header IN LISTS _headers)
      math(EXPR _header_count "${_header_count} + 1")
      set(_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/header_${_header_count}.cpp")
      file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${_header}" _include)
      file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT "${_source}" CONTENT "#include \"${_include}\"\n" @ONLY)
      target_sources(public_headers PRIVATE "${_source}")
      # ParquetFile exposes Arrow types. Supply that existing dependency only
      # to its header unit; the plain OpenMS consumer below does not need it.
      if(_include MATCHES "/FORMAT/ParquetFile\\.h$")
        if(NOT OPENMS_ARROW_INCLUDE_DIRS)
          message(FATAL_ERROR "ParquetFile.h requires the producer's Arrow include directories")
        endif()
        set_source_files_properties("${_source}" PROPERTIES
          INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_poison};${OPENMS_ARROW_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endforeach()
endforeach()
if(_header_count LESS 100)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Expected the complete installed header sets, got ${_header_count} headers")
endif()
message(STATUS "Checking ${_header_count} installed headers without Boost")

add_executable(boost_free main.cpp)
target_include_directories(boost_free BEFORE PRIVATE "${_poison}")
target_link_libraries(boost_free PRIVATE OpenMS::OpenMS)
add_test(NAME boost_free COMMAND boost_free)
if(WIN32)
  set_property(TEST boost_free APPEND PROPERTY
    ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION "PATH=path_list_prepend:${OPENMS_LIB_DIR}")
endif()
